svg.title: Section through the pivot, New England vs Florida
svg.desc: Existing ground, design and as-built surface along a diameter through the pivot for the sloped New England till site and the flat Florida sand lot, drawn to the same scale.
svg.text: Section through the pivot: New England till on a 6 ft slope vs a flat Florida lot
New England glacial till, 6 ft slope
outer moat: one waterline, cut 2.76 m deep on the high side
flat ground: both banks the same depth; water table 0.9 m down
